# WeUI vendored style

- Package: `weui-wxss`
- Version: `2.6.26`
- Source: https://github.com/Tencent/weui-wxss
- File used: `dist-rpx-mode/style/weui.wxss`
- License: MIT; see `WEUI-LICENSE.txt`

The repository does not depend on a globally installed npm executable. The official rpx build is vendored here so WeChat Developer Tools can compile the same reviewed file on every machine without an additional package-build step.
